en.name: Cardigan Rugby Club
en.fact: Cardigan RFC was founded in 1876. Its clubhouse and home ground are on Gwbert Road.

cy.name: Clwb Rygbi Aberteifi
cy.fact: Sefydlwyd Clwb Rygbi Aberteifi yn 1876. Mae’r clwb a’i faes cartref ar Heol Gwbert.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the clubhouse. Decide whether guesses on the adjacent home pitch should also earn full marks.

en.name: Wildlife Centre
en.fact: The centre sits in Teifi Marshes nature reserve, a wetland home to kingfishers, wading birds and otters.

cy.name: Canolfan Bywyd Gwyllt Cymru
cy.fact: Mae’r ganolfan yng ngwarchodfa Corsydd Teifi, cartref gwlyptir i las y dorlan, adar hirgoes a dyfrgwn.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: The Black Lion
en.fact: Cardigan’s town council met at the Black Lion in the eighteenth century; the inn also hosted auctions and public gatherings.

cy.name: Y Black Lion
cy.fact: Cyfarfu cyngor tref Aberteifi yn y Black Lion yn y ddeunawfed ganrif; cynhaliwyd arwerthiannau a chyfarfodydd cyhoeddus yno hefyd.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Spar
en.fact: This North Road shop is also known as North End Stores.

cy.name: Spar
cy.fact: Gelwir y siop hon ar Heol y Gogledd hefyd yn North End Stores.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Our Lady of the Taper Catholic Church
en.fact: The church became the Welsh National Shrine of Our Lady in 1986. Its statue of Mary holds a burning taper.

cy.name: Eglwys Gatholig Mair o Aberteifi
cy.fact: Daeth yr eglwys yn Gysegr Cenedlaethol Cymru i Fair yn 1986. Mae cerflun Mair yn dal cannwyll yn llosgi.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Tesco Superstore
en.fact: The superstore stands on Aberystwyth Road, on the north-eastern side of town; the petrol station is a separate building.

cy.name: Tesco Superstore
cy.fact: Saif yr archfarchnad ar Heol Aberystwyth, yng ngogledd-ddwyrain y dref; mae’r orsaf betrol mewn adeilad ar wahân.

places.reviewNotes: Pin uses the supermarket building, not the petrol station or the less precise FSA address point.

en.name: Penparc
en.fact: Penparc lies on the A487 north-east of Cardigan, near the glacial sand and gravel deposits around Banc-y-Warren.

cy.name: Penparc
cy.fact: Mae Penparc ar yr A487 i’r gogledd-ddwyrain o Aberteifi, ger dyddodion tywod a graean rhewlifol Banc-y-Warren.

places.reviewNotes: Village reference point is inside the current bounds. Eastern outskirts approach the boundary. Define a village polygon; do not score against this single point.

en.name: Cardigan Golf Club
en.fact: Founded in 1895, the club’s course overlooks Cardigan Bay from the hills above the Teifi estuary.

cy.name: Clwb Golff Aberteifi
cy.fact: Sefydlwyd y clwb yn 1895. Mae ei gwrs yn edrych dros Fae Ceredigion o’r bryniau uwchlaw aber Afon Teifi.

places.reviewNotes: Reference point is the whole course, not the clubhouse. OSM notes uncertainty in parts of its boundary. Review the accepted course area or rename the target to the clubhouse.

en.name: The Angel Hotel
en.fact: The Angel was hosting auctions by 1806 and appears on John Wood’s 1834 map of Cardigan.

cy.name: Gwesty’r Angel
cy.fact: Roedd yr Angel yn cynnal arwerthiannau erbyn 1806 ac mae ar fap John Wood o Aberteifi yn 1834.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Pont y Cleifion bridge
en.fact: The A487 bypass crosses the Teifi east of the town centre on the bridge mapped as Priory Bridge / Pont y Priordy.

cy.name: Pont y Cleifion
cy.fact: Mae ffordd osgoi’r A487 yn croesi Afon Teifi i’r dwyrain o ganol y dref ar Bont y Priordy.

places.reviewNotes: Owner confirmed the A487 bypass bridge. Pin is the bridge structure centre, not the nearby street named Pont-y-Cleifion.

en.name: Albion Aberteifi
en.fact: The old wharf warehouses preserve nineteenth-century pencil sketches of tall ships and calculations for ropes and sails.

cy.name: Albion Aberteifi
cy.fact: Mae hen warysau’r cei yn cadw brasluniau pensil o longau tal a chyfrifiadau ar gyfer rhaffau a hwyliau o’r bedwaredd ganrif ar bymtheg.

places.reviewNotes: FSA premises point for Bridge Warehouse, Castle Street. Confirm the precise hotel building centre; OSM has not supplied a named hotel feature here.

en.name: The Grosvenor
en.fact: The Grosvenor stands on Bridge Street opposite Cardigan Castle, with its terrace looking over the Teifi.

cy.name: Y Grosvenor
cy.fact: Saif y Grosvenor ar Heol y Bont gyferbyn â Chastell Aberteifi, gyda’i deras yn edrych dros Afon Teifi.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: The Ferry Inn
en.fact: The riverside inn overlooks the tidal Teifi from terraces on Poppit Road.

cy.name: Y Ferry Inn
cy.fact: Mae’r dafarn ar lan yr afon yn edrych dros ran lanwol Afon Teifi o derasau ar Heol Poppit.

places.reviewNotes: OSM pub point is used; FSA geocoding is about 75 m away. Check the exact pub centre.

en.name: St Dogmaels Football Club
en.fact: The club plays at School Field and won four consecutive Ceredigion League Division One titles from 1991–92 to 1994–95.

cy.name: Clwb Pêl-droed Llandudoch
cy.fact: Mae’r clwb yn chwarae ar Faes yr Ysgol ac enillodd bedwar teitl Adran Un Cynghrair Ceredigion yn olynol rhwng 1991–92 a 1994–95.

places.reviewNotes: Football pitch centre, cross-checked against the Football Club History Database. Accept the pitch footprint rather than demand its exact centre.

en.name: B V Rees Car Dealer
en.fact: Founded in 1948, B V Rees is a family-run dealership based at Abbey Garage in St Dogmaels.

cy.name: B V Rees
cy.fact: Sefydlwyd B V Rees yn 1948. Mae’r busnes ceir teuluol yn Abbey Garage yn Llandudoch.

places.reviewNotes: Abbey Garage / Fiat showroom selected. There is also a second B V Rees showroom roughly 160 m north-east: confirm which site should count, or accept both.

en.name: Maesglas estate
en.fact: The Maesglas housing estate gave its name to Maesglas Football Club, founded by five local youngsters in 1974.

cy.name: Ystad Maesglas
cy.fact: Rhoddodd ystad Maesglas ei henw i Glwb Pêl-droed Maesglas, a sefydlwyd gan bum person ifanc lleol yn 1974.

places.reviewNotes: Approximate estate reference point inferred from its mapped roads. The whole estate is intended, not the football ground at Netpool. Draw and review a polygon before enabling.

en.name: Netpool Play Area
en.fact: This riverside play area is mapped as a natural playground with earth mounds, crawling tubes and large rocks.

cy.name: Maes Chwarae Netpool
cy.fact: Mae’r maes chwarae ar lan yr afon wedi’i fapio fel maes chwarae naturiol gyda thwmpathau pridd, twneli cropian a chreigiau mawr.

places.reviewNotes: This is the Cardigan Netpool playground, not the Netpool Inn in St Dogmaels. Fact describes the mapped layout; check it still matches locally.

en.name: Teifi Otter Statue
en.fact: Geoffrey Powell’s bronze otter was presented by David Bellamy in 1988 to mark the Dyfed Wildlife Trust’s golden jubilee.

cy.name: Dwrgi’r Teifi
cy.fact: Cyflwynwyd dwrgi efydd Geoffrey Powell gan David Bellamy yn 1988 i nodi jiwbilî aur Ymddiriedolaeth Bywyd Gwyllt Dyfed.

places.reviewNotes: Bronze otter by the castle/bridge, not the large willow otter at the Wildlife Centre. Fact is supported by the photographed plaque.

en.name: The Gwbert Hotel
en.fact: The hotel overlooks the Teifi estuary; its restaurant is named the Flat Rock.

cy.name: Gwesty Gwbert
cy.fact: Mae’r gwesty yn edrych dros aber Afon Teifi; enw ei fwyty yw’r Flat Rock.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Teifi Boating Club
en.fact: Based at The Patch on the Teifi estuary, the club welcomes dinghies, cruisers and powerboats.

cy.name: Clwb Cychod Teifi
cy.fact: Mae’r clwb yn The Patch ar aber Afon Teifi ac yn croesawu dingis, cychod mordeithio a chychod modur.

places.reviewNotes: Difficulty 2 confirmed by owner. Reference point is the marina footprint; review whether the whole site or just the clubhouse should count.

en.name: Abdul’s Tandoori Spice
en.fact: This Indian and tandoori restaurant occupies 2 Royal Oak on Quay Street, beside Cardigan’s old waterfront.

cy.name: Abdul’s Tandoori Spice
cy.fact: Mae’r bwyty Indiaidd a thandoori hwn yn 2 Royal Oak ar Heol y Cei, ger hen lan y dŵr Aberteifi.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Pendre Fish and Chips
en.fact: Pendre Café is a fish-and-chip café and takeaway on Pendre, north of the High Street.

cy.name: Pendre Fish and Chips
cy.fact: Mae Caffi Pendre yn gaffi a siop pysgod a sglodion ar Bendre, i’r gogledd o’r Stryd Fawr.

places.reviewNotes: Pendre Café, 16 Pendre is the researched match. OSM building centre is about 80 m north-east of the FSA/listing pin. Confirm exact premises; council tourism PDF also inconsistently says 1 Pendre.

en.name: Brondesbury Lodge
en.fact: Brondesbury Lodge is a purpose-built nursing and residential care home on Heol Derw.

cy.name: Brondesbury Lodge
cy.fact: Mae Brondesbury Lodge yn gartref nyrsio a gofal preswyl pwrpasol ar Heol Derw.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Banc-y-Warren summit
en.fact: The summit is 146 metres high. The hill is traditionally associated with the Battle of Crug Mawr in 1136, although the battle’s precise location is uncertain.

cy.name: Copa Banc-y-Warren
cy.fact: Mae’r copa 146 metr o uchder. Cysylltir y bryn yn draddodiadol â Brwydr Crug Mawr yn 1136, ond mae union leoliad y frwydr yn ansicr.

places.reviewNotes: Owner confirmed the hill itself. Target the summit/trig point, not the quarry or wider Banc-y-Warren area. Elevation from the OSM summit record.

en.name: Llangoedmor
en.fact: This scattered village east of Cardigan has a church dedicated to St Cynllo; its former village school was built in 1848–49.

cy.name: Llangoedmor
cy.fact: Mae gan y pentref gwasgaredig hwn i’r dwyrain o Aberteifi eglwys wedi’i chysegru i Gynllo Sant; adeiladwyd hen ysgol y pentref yn 1848–49.

places.reviewNotes: Village reference point only. Coflein describes a widely dispersed settlement: agree which village area counts before enabling, rather than using the whole administrative community.

en.name: Mantle Brewery
en.fact: This family-run microbrewery makes Welsh real ales at Pentood Industrial Estate, including Cwrw Teifi.

cy.name: Bragdy Mantle
cy.fact: Mae’r microfragdy teuluol hwn yn cynhyrchu cwrw go iawn Cymreig ar Ystad Ddiwydiannol Pentood, gan gynnwys Cwrw Teifi.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Ferwig
en.fact: The village’s church is dedicated to St Pedrog. Its medieval west tower survived the Victorian rebuilding but was demolished in 1968.

cy.name: Y Ferwig
cy.fact: Cysegrwyd eglwys y pentref i Bedrog Sant. Goroesodd ei thŵr gorllewinol canoloesol yr ailadeiladu Fictoraidd ond fe’i dymchwelwyd yn 1968.

places.reviewNotes: Village reference point only, not the much larger Y Ferwig community. Agree a village scoring boundary.

en.name: Cardigan Sand & Gravel
en.fact: Established in 1959, this family business extracts sands and gravels laid down by meltwater rivers at the edge of a retreating glacier.

cy.name: Cardigan Sand & Gravel
cy.fact: Sefydlwyd y busnes teuluol yn 1959. Mae’n cloddio tywod a graean a adawyd gan afonydd dŵr tawdd ar ymyl rhewlif yn cilio.

places.reviewNotes: Approximate quarry reference from a photographed subject location, not a verified office/entrance. Confirm intended target and quarry boundary; do not use the nearby recycling centre or electricity substation.

en.name: Cardiff Arms
en.fact: The nineteenth-century inn is built from Cilgerran stone and is Grade II listed as one of the village’s least altered buildings.

cy.name: Cardiff Arms
cy.fact: Adeiladwyd y dafarn o gerrig Cilgerran yn y bedwaredd ganrif ar bymtheg. Mae’n adeilad rhestredig Gradd II ac yn un o adeiladau’r pentref sydd wedi newid leiaf.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin and Welsh wording locally before enabling.

en.name: Cardigan Railway Station (former site)
en.fact: The station opened in 1886 as the terminus of the Whitland and Cardigan Railway. Passenger services ended in 1962.

cy.name: Gorsaf Reilffordd Aberteifi (hen safle)
cy.fact: Agorwyd yr orsaf yn 1886 fel terfynfa Rheilffordd Hendy-gwyn ar Daf ac Aberteifi. Daeth gwasanaethau teithwyr i ben yn 1962.

places.reviewNotes: Historical reference point, cross-checked with Coflein grid reference SN1805045818. Confirm the former passenger station footprint, rather than the surviving goods shed or Tivy Tyres next door.

en.name: Pen-y-Bryn
en.fact: The settlement sits at a crossroads on the southern approach to Cardigan, beside the Pen-y-Bryn Arms and Baptist chapel.

cy.name: Pen-y-Bryn
cy.fact: Mae’r pentref ar groesffordd ar y ffordd ddeheuol i Aberteifi, ger y Pen-y-Bryn Arms a’r capel Bedyddwyr.

places.reviewNotes: Assumed the village near Bridell/Cilgerran, not a same-named holiday cottage in Penparc. Agree a settlement boundary.

en.name: Blaenwaun Baptist Chapel
en.fact: The first chapel here was built in 1745 with a thatched roof. The congregation also had a separate open-air baptismal pool downhill.

cy.name: Capel Bedyddwyr Blaenwaun
cy.fact: Adeiladwyd y capel cyntaf yma yn 1745 gyda tho gwellt. Roedd gan y gynulleidfa bwll bedydd awyr agored ar wahân i lawr y bryn hefyd.

places.reviewNotes: Target the chapel itself. Its listed baptismal pool is a separate site roughly 300 m north-west.

en.name: Tivy Tyres
en.fact: This tyre-fitting business is in the old station yard on Station Road, beside the former Cardigan railway station site.

cy.name: Tivy Tyres
cy.fact: Mae’r busnes teiars hwn yn hen iard yr orsaf ar Heol yr Orsaf, ger hen safle gorsaf reilffordd Aberteifi.

places.reviewNotes: Business spelling is Tivy Tyres. OSM records an outdated address on its Facebook page; use the mapped Station Yard building, not an old Pentood unit.

en.name: Cardigan Guildhall
en.fact: The Guildhall and adjoining market halls were built in 1858–60 as a new civic centre for the town.

cy.name: Neuadd y Dref Aberteifi
cy.fact: Adeiladwyd Neuadd y Dref a’r neuaddau marchnad cyfagos yn 1858–60 fel canolfan ddinesig newydd i’r dref.

places.reviewNotes: Aim for the Guildhall building, rather than the market hall behind it. The cannon is a separate nearby candidate. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Cardigan Bridge (old town bridge)
en.fact: Cardigan’s old bridge crosses the Teifi beside the castle. A river crossing here was part of the medieval town.

cy.name: Pont Aberteifi (hen bont y dref)
cy.fact: Mae hen bont Aberteifi yn croesi’r Teifi wrth y castell. Roedd croesfan dros yr afon yma yn rhan o’r dref ganoloesol.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the middle of the old bridge, not the A487 bypass bridge. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Y Felin watermill
en.fact: Y Felin still uses water power to grind flour with millstones. The mill was restored in the late 1970s.

cy.name: Y Felin
cy.fact: Mae Y Felin yn dal i ddefnyddio pŵer dŵr i falu blawd â meini melin. Adferwyd y felin ddiwedd y 1970au.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the mill building, not its pond. Close to the abbey: check whether difficulty 1 is appropriate. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: RNLI Lifeboat Station
en.fact: Cardigan’s two inshore lifeboats launch from Poppit Sands and cover the tidal Teifi as well as the coast.

cy.name: Gorsaf Bad Achub yr RNLI
cy.fact: Mae dau fad achub glannau Aberteifi yn lansio o Draeth Poppit ac yn gwasanaethu rhan lanwol y Teifi yn ogystal â’r arfordir.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the present station building. Do not confuse it with the old lifeboat house at Cei Bach. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Crwst café, Priory Street
en.fact: Crwst’s Cardigan café serves coffee, pastries and brunch. Its pastries and dishes are made in-house using locally sourced ingredients.

cy.name: Caffi Crwst, Stryd y Priordy
cy.fact: Mae caffi Crwst yn Aberteifi yn gweini coffi, teisennau a brecinio. Gwneir y teisennau a’r prydau yn y caffi gan ddefnyddio cynhwysion lleol.

places.reviewNotes: This is the Priory Street café, not the production bakery at Parc Teifi or the Poppit café. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Teifi Leisure Centre
en.fact: Teifi Leisure Centre is run by Ceredigion Actif and offers fitness classes and a fitness suite.

cy.name: Canolfan Hamdden Teifi
cy.fact: Mae Canolfan Hamdden Teifi yn cael ei rhedeg gan Ceredigion Actif ac yn cynnig dosbarthiadau ffitrwydd ac ystafell ffitrwydd.

places.reviewNotes: OSM node is a provisional reference point. Check the exact building pin; avoid treating the whole adjoining school campus as the target. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Small World Theatre
en.fact: Small World Theatre brings people together through puppetry, performance and creative programmes. Its Cardigan venue also hosts aerial classes.

cy.name: Theatr Byd Bach
cy.fact: Mae Theatr Byd Bach yn dod â phobl ynghyd drwy bypedwaith, perfformiadau a rhaglenni creadigol. Mae ei lleoliad yn Aberteifi hefyd yn cynnal dosbarthiadau awyr.

places.reviewNotes: OSM uses Theatr Byd Bychan; the current organisation website uses Theatr Byd Bach. Welsh name follows the official website. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: St Mary’s Church
en.fact: St Mary’s has a fourteenth-century chancel. Its west tower was rebuilt in 1748.

cy.name: Eglwys y Santes Fair
cy.fact: Mae gan Eglwys y Santes Fair gangell o’r bedwaredd ganrif ar ddeg. Ailadeiladwyd ei thŵr gorllewinol yn 1748.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the church building, not the surrounding churchyard. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Library at the Council Offices (Morgan Street)
en.fact: This target is the library at the council offices on Morgan Street, rather than the library in the arcade. Its collections include the Tivy-Side newspaper on microfilm.

cy.name: Llyfrgell Swyddfeydd y Cyngor (Stryd Morgan)
cy.fact: Y targed hwn yw’r llyfrgell yn swyddfeydd y cyngor ar Stryd Morgan, yn hytrach na’r llyfrgell yn yr arcêd. Mae ei chasgliadau’n cynnwys papur newydd y Tivy-Side ar ficroffilm.

places.reviewNotes: Target the library at the council offices on Morgan Street, not the library in the arcade. The arcade library’s current opening/closure status has not been confirmed. Check the shared council-office/library building pin and Welsh wording locally.

en.name: Crwst beach café
en.fact: Crwst has a café beside Poppit Sands, serving pastries, filled rolls, drinks and ice cream near the beach.

cy.name: Caffi traeth Crwst
cy.fact: Mae gan Crwst gaffi wrth Draeth Poppit, yn gweini teisennau, rholiau wedi eu llenwi, diodydd a hufen iâ ger y traeth.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the café building, not the car park or the nearby lifeboat station. Close neighbours within the current 50 m scoring tolerance. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: St Thomas’ Church
en.fact: St Thomas’ Church was built in 1847 within the abbey precincts, using stone from the ruined abbey buildings.

cy.name: Eglwys Sant Thomas
cy.fact: Adeiladwyd Eglwys Sant Thomas yn 1847 o fewn tiroedd yr abaty, gan ddefnyddio cerrig o adfeilion adeiladau’r abaty.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the parish church, not the abbey ruins or the Coach House. These targets are close together. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Yr Hen Printworks
en.fact: Before becoming a restaurant in 2021, this building was Hope Chapel and later a printworks where the Tivyside newspaper was printed.

cy.name: Yr Hen Printworks
cy.fact: Cyn dod yn fwyty yn 2021, roedd yr adeilad hwn yn Gapel Hope ac yn ddiweddarach yn argraffdy lle argraffwyd papur newydd y Tivyside.

places.reviewNotes: Check the pin on the converted chapel building and the suggested difficulty. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: GRAIN
en.fact: GRAIN’s Cardigan venue serves pizza and craft beer by the River Teifi.

cy.name: GRAIN
cy.fact: Mae lleoliad GRAIN yn Aberteifi yn gweini pizza a chwrw crefft wrth Afon Teifi.

places.reviewNotes: OSM maps a venue node; confirm the precise premises and whether its current name is familiar locally. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Cardigan Primary School
en.fact: Cardigan Primary School is on Napier Street. Its Welsh name is Ysgol Gynradd Aberteifi.

cy.name: Ysgol Gynradd Aberteifi
cy.fact: Mae Ysgol Gynradd Aberteifi ar Stryd Napier. Dyma ysgol gynradd y dref.

places.reviewNotes: School grounds are an area target. Agree the accepted footprint or choose a named building before using it in a daily puzzle. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Russian cannon outside the Guildhall
en.fact: The cannon was placed in front of Cardigan’s Guildhall on 22 May 1871.

cy.name: Y canon Rwsiaidd y tu allan i Neuadd y Dref
cy.fact: Gosodwyd y canon o flaen Neuadd y Dref Aberteifi ar 22 Mai 1871.

places.reviewNotes: Tiny target beside the Guildhall; the 50 m full-score radius makes these two targets overlap. Avoid neighbouring days. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Mermaid sculpture
en.fact: A mermaid sculpture stands by the Teifi at St Dogmaels, where local folklore tells of a fisherman and a mermaid.

cy.name: Cerflun y fôr-forwyn
cy.fact: Saif cerflun o fôr-forwyn wrth y Teifi yn Llandudoch, lle mae llên gwerin leol yn adrodd hanes pysgotwr a môr-forwyn.

places.reviewNotes: Confirm the sculpture still occupies this mapped spot. Very close to the coast-path marker: current score radii overlap. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Pembrokeshire Coast Path start/end marker
en.fact: St Dogmaels marks the northern end of the Pembrokeshire Coast Path National Trail.

cy.name: Carreg dechrau/diwedd Llwybr Arfordir Penfro
cy.fact: Mae Llandudoch yn nodi pen gogleddol Llwybr Arfordir Penfro, un o Lwybrau Cenedlaethol Cymru.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the stone marker itself. Nearby mermaid sculpture shares almost the same scoring area. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Kingfisher Hide
en.fact: Kingfisher Hide overlooks Kingfisher Pond, also known as the Bass Lagoon, in Teifi Marshes nature reserve.

cy.name: Cuddfan Glas y Dorlan
cy.fact: Mae Cuddfan Glas y Dorlan yn edrych dros Bwll Glas y Dorlan, a elwir hefyd yn Lagŵn Bass, yng ngwarchodfa Corsydd Teifi.

places.reviewNotes: The hide was rebuilt after a fire. OSM node is an older GPS reference; check the current hide pin and preferred Welsh name locally. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: Old lifeboat house
en.fact: A new lifeboat house was built here in 1876 at a cost of £450. Cardigan’s station later reopened at Poppit Sands in 1971.

cy.name: Hen dŷ’r bad achub
cy.fact: Adeiladwyd tŷ bad achub newydd yma yn 1876 am £450. Ailagorodd gorsaf Aberteifi yn ddiweddarach ar Draeth Poppit yn 1971.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the surviving old boathouse at Cei Bach, not the present Poppit station. Historic-site identification is corroborated by the BBC St Dogmaels walk. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: St Cynllo’s Church
en.fact: St Cynllo’s has an unusual classical spire made of grey Cilgerran stone, with two tiers above a slender obelisk.

cy.name: Eglwys Sant Cynllo
cy.fact: Mae gan Eglwys Sant Cynllo feindwr clasurol anarferol o garreg lwyd Cilgerran, gyda dwy haen uwchben obelisg main.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the church building. Suggested difficulty 3; check local familiarity and Welsh wording. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

en.name: St Llawddog’s Church
en.fact: St Llawddog’s retains a medieval west tower. Much of the rest of the present church was rebuilt in 1853–55.

cy.name: Eglwys Sant Llawddog
cy.fact: Mae Eglwys Sant Llawddog yn cadw tŵr gorllewinol canoloesol. Ailadeiladwyd llawer o weddill yr eglwys bresennol yn 1853–55.

places.reviewNotes: Pin is the church building, not the separate inscribed stone in its churchyard. Suggested difficulty and Welsh wording need local review.

researchBatches.description: Independent web research; seven suggested targets at each difficulty. Confirm before daily scheduling.
